summary: Package root for the expression AST system. Re-exports the fluent entry points (col, lit, when, coalesce, t_col, native, ...), the BooleanExpressionAPI classes, and the AST introspection helpers (walk, iter_child_nodes, collect_field_references); importing it registers all backend expression systems. Also holds loose utilities: runtime_imports (optional-dependency probes), introspect, core/output_names (output-name resolution), core/datetime_components and core/utils/temporal.
key_classes: ExpressionOutputs — resolved output-name result for an expression (core/output_names.py)
key_functions: walk(node, order='depth_first') — iterate every node in an expression AST (DFS or BFS)
iter_child_nodes(node) — direct ExpressionNode children one level down
resolve_output_names(expression, *, input_names=None) — compute output column names for an expression
require_module(module_name, install_hint=None) — import optional dependency or raise a helpful error
get_available_backends() — report which backends are importable
extension_points: Backends register via the expression-system registry when `from . import backends` runs at package import
introspect.py is the supported AST walk surface consumed by validation
lifecycle_notes: introspect.py added as public AST introspection (backlog item 226a)
Recent: 1c72e96a merge of feature/371-expression-lowering-reuse (lowering reuse in visitor)
risks: Large surface (~25k lines); package __init__ docstring still lists 'Pandas' as supported while backends are Polars/Narwhals/Ibis
Importing the package eagerly imports backends, which register expression systems
Adding any op needs six-layer wiring (wiring-matrix principle)

evidence.detail: __all__ lists entry points, API classes, introspection helpers
Aligned with minimal-ast, build-then-compile and polars-api-substrait-ast principles
